description: This Java source file defines the ProxyUtils class, providing utility methods for handling HTTP redirects, 404 responses, and request validation within the Spark on YARN deployment, specifically migrating from javax.servlet to jakarta.servlet.

classes.name: ProxyUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling HTTP redirects, 404 responses, and request validation in Spark's YARN deployment, migrated to use jakarta.servlet.

methods.name: sendRedirect
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirect responses with support for future REST verbs, outputs a simple HTML page indicating redirection.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Outputs a 404 Not Found response with a custom message.

methods.name: rejectNonHttpRequests
methods.description: Rejects requests that are not instances of HttpServletRequest, throwing ServletException.
